title: p&c claims intake (fnol): before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 34 min of staff time per claim

steps.task: Open the email, web form or call note and its attachments; file them to the claim folder
Find the policy in the policy admin system; confirm it was in force on the loss date
Set up the claim: key date, place, cause, parties, vehicles or property
Read the schedule and wording; check peril, exclusions, excess and limits
Review photos, police report and repair estimate; note what is missing
Check fraud indicators: recent inception, late notice, prior claims, story fit
Set the severity band and route to an adjuster queue by authority level
Send the acknowledgement and request missing documents

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 6 min of human review per claim

steps.task: Watch inbox, web form and call-centre notes; OCR documents; dedupe repeat notices
Label line, loss type, document types and urgency (injury, home uninhabitable)
Pull FNOL fields from text, documents and photos, each with a source citation
Fetch the policy as at the loss date, endorsements and claim history by API
Compare loss facts to the wording; flag exclusions and limits with clause citations
Score rule hits and narrative gaps (Batch API); never accuses, only flags for review
Set severity band, pick the queue from the authority matrix, draft the acknowledgement
Check the intake summary, resolve flags, release the claim to the adjuster
Owns reserves, payments and any denial; SIU reviews high fraud scores
